As Marketing Manager, Nordics, you will be responsible for developing and executing the marketing strategy and annual marketing plan for one of our business channels across the Nordic region, in line with company objectives, regional priorities, and global strategy.

You will play a key role in accelerating business growth by identifying market opportunities, driving customer engagement, strengthening customer adoption, and delivering impactful marketing initiatives that support our commercial objectives.

Working closely with commercial, clinical, and regional marketing teams, you will translate customer insights into effective marketing programs that drive customer success and long-term business performance.

You will report to the Senior Marketing Manager, Nordics and be based in Copenhagen, with regular travel across the Nordic region.

Role expectations

Strategic Growth & Business Development

• Lead the strategic growth of your assigned business channel across the Nordics by identifying and executing high-impact growth opportunities in alignment with EMEA strategy and in close collaboration with the commercial organization and Senior Marketing Manager.

• Proactively represents the Nordic region and our customers by providing market insights, customer feedback, competitive intelligence, and business analytics to support new product development and global strategy.

• Identify local growth opportunities and champion initiatives that support business expansion beyond regional marketing plans.

• 
Focus on end-to-end excellence across products, services, and customer experiences while maintaining a broad market perspective and identifying future opportunities.

• 
Generate actionable customer, market, and competitive insights to shape commercial priorities and marketing investments.

Marketing Planning & Execution

• Develop and execute the annual marketing plan for the assigned business channel, ensuring alignment with commercial objectives, company strategy, regional priorities, and global direction.

• Lead and execute channel marketing initiatives, including congresses, summits, customer events, speaker programs, educational activities, marketing playbooks, digital campaigns, and customer engagement programs.

• Own the end-to-end planning and delivery of key initiatives by defining timelines, responsibilities, materials, agency deliverables, stakeholder briefings, field team alignment, attendance where relevant, and post-activity follow-up.

• Champion regional and central marketing programs locally in close collaboration with sales, clinical, and regional teams, ensuring activities are translated into clear and practical execution for the Nordic markets.

• Use analytics and insights, including campaign ROI, customer reimbursement trends, market dynamics, competitive activity, and customer feedback, to continuously optimize marketing performance and improve future activities.

• Support successful product launches, commercialization strategies, and customer adoption initiatives.

KOL & Customer Engagement

• 
Build and maintain strong relationships with KOLs, speakers, key customers, institutions, and professional associations across the Nordics.

• Partner with external stakeholders to deliver educational, scientific, and professional initiatives that strengthen customer engagement and thought leadership.

• Identify, brief, and support speakers and KOLs for congresses, educational programs, and customer-facing activities.

Cross-Functional Leadership

• Partner closely with Commercial, Clinical, Finance, Education, Regional Marketing, and local country teams to ensure aligned execution and measurable business impact.

• Provide channel expertise, customer insights, campaign materials, messaging, and practical guidance to support successful local execution.

• 
Build stakeholder alignment across functions and markets to drive implementation of strategic initiatives.

Digital Marketing & Innovation

• Utilize digital communication platforms, marketing technologies, AI-enabled tools, automation solutions, and analytics platforms to deliver and optimize marketing activities.

• Deliver integrated omnichannel campaigns that enhance customer engagement throughout the customer journey building the future of Digital dentistry.

• Explore innovative approaches to customer engagement and continuously evaluate emerging marketing trends and leverage EMEA and global best practices

Training & Capability Building (consider erasing – repetition)

• Train and educate country stakeholders on relevant aspects of the business channel, customer journey, brand strategy, products, and marketing initiatives.

• Develop training materials and supporting collateral to enable effective execution across local teams and share best practices, customer insights, and market learnings to support continuous improvement across the Nordic organization.

What we're looking for

Experience

• 4+ years of relevant experience in B2B or healthcare marketing, preferably within the medical device, pharmaceutical, healthcare, life sciences, or Fast-Moving Consumer Healthcare (FMCH) industries.

• Demonstrated experience developing and implementing successful marketing strategies and campaigns.

• Experience working cross-functionally with commercial, clinical, and field-based teams.

• Experience managing agencies, events, and external partners.

• Proven ability to use data and insights to drive decision-making and business results.

• Hands-on experience with congress participation, event execution, agency coordination, customer-facing activities, digital campaigns, marketing materials, and follow-up processes.

Skills

• Strong strategic mindset and commercial acumen.

• Ability to identify growth opportunities and translate insights into actionable initiatives.

• Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.

• Excellent project management and organizational capabilities.

• Ability to work independently and navigate a matrix organization.

• Comfortable balancing strategic planning with hands-on execution.

• Proactive problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail.

• Results-oriented and customer-focused approach.

• Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.

**

Qualifications**

• Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Life Sciences, or a related discipline is required; a Master’s degree is considered an advantage.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and AI-enabled productivity tools.

• Fluent in English.

• Fluent in Danish or Swedish.

Design for the people in the tiny chairs

At Famly, we build software that takes admin off the plates of early-years educators, so they can spend their time where it matters - with the children. And we make it easier for over a million parents to stay close to their child's day, even while they're at work.

We're looking for a design system builder to join the design team - responsible for the design system, prototyping tools and all other infrastructure with the goal of driving consistency and coherence across the entire product.

About Famly

We’re on a mission to stop admin stealing the joy of working with young children. We do that with our platform, the world’s first proactive assistant for educators and staff that handles admin for them so they can get back to what they love. And we do it with our content (like The Tiny Chair Podcast), reminding educators of the joy and meaning that got them into working with children in the first place.

About the role

You live where design and code meet. With a small team, you'll own Famly's design system: the components, patterns, and documentation that product teams (and increasingly, AI agents) build on every day.

The team's job is coherence. Every feature and every domain should feel like it came from the same place. You'll give builders what they need to design and build to our standards, and keep the conversation going so the system keeps getting better.

You'll bring deep technical knowledge of design systems, and you'll care just as much about how the product feels to the people using it.

The team is based in our Copenhagen office, but we are open to you being based somewhere else.

What you'll be doing

• 
Build production-quality React and TypeScript components for Famly's design system.

• 
Design component APIs that are hard to misuse, and version them so upgrades don't break product teams.

• 
Write the documentation that makes those components self-serve, so a new engineer or an AI agent can pick one up and use it correctly without asking anyone.

• 
Keep the system trustworthy: tests, visual regression, and a release process people don't dread.

• 
Learn Famly's frontend deeply enough to know where a pattern lives, who depends on it, and what breaks if it changes.

• 
Audit and evolve the components we already have, for consistency, accessibility, and reuse across the product.

• 
Own the code side of the design standard with a small team, so design intent survives the trip into production.

• 
Push back when a design won't hold up in code - too many states, no empty case, a pattern that already exists - and say what you'd do instead.

• 
Work with PMs, designers, and engineers across product teams, and bring them ideas before they ask.

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

• 
You have 5+ years of frontend experience in B2B SaaS, including design system work.

• 
You're strong in React, TypeScript, and CSS.

• 
You have taste for craft: spacing, motion, states, and the details that make a component feel finished.

• 
You think in systems: reusable, documented, maintainable components over one-off fixes.

• 
You get from a rough idea to a working prototype fast.

• 
You own your work end to end, from discovery through testing to shipping.

• 
You care about the difference between "works" and "is right," and you'll say so and set the direction.

The interview process looks like:

• 
Short meet and greet with Lead People Partner

• 
A logical test

• 
1st interview: Meet and greet with our Senior Director of Product Design

• 
Take-home assignment

• 
2nd interview: Assignment presentation with Senior Director of Product Design and Lead Designer

And who are Famly?

You’re probably wondering at this stage, and Famly are...? Well, it all began when our co-founder Henrik’s daughter was ready to start at daycare. He couldn’t believe the amount of work being done on paper - and how distant he felt from his first child during the day. The paper ‘parent’ books they exchanged once a month just weren’t cutting it. Together with his friend, our co-founder and CEO Anders, they set about solving that.

These days, about 180 of us build Famly for more than 10,000 institutions and over 1 million parents.

We handle admin stress so they can get back to what matters, and we make it easier than ever to connect home, and nursery so parents can play a part in their child’s day. If you join us, you’ll be building, selling, or support customers with everything from staff rotas and invoices, to child development and parent communication.

How we work

Famly prides itself on a few principles; we choose simplicity, we believe friendliness is a superpower, we set the pace, and we want everyone to be surrounded by talent.

It all adds up to a culture that refuses to make employees choose between a place that is ambitious and sets the pace for what good looks like - and one that is a nice place to work. We think you can be ambitious and kind and when you get to meet our team, we hope you’ll agree.

What we expect of you, is that you make others shine, that you believe in being better than yesterday, and you are not afraid to just ‘get it done’. Finally, we want you to value ‘sitting in the tiny chair’ - which means you look at your work through the impact it has on our customers: the people sitting in tiny chairs in childcare settings all over the world.

What’s in it for you?

• 
Competitive pension, private health insurance, and paid maternity/paternity leave.

• 
A clear career framework and coaching to make sure you’re growing, a $1000 personal development budget and a ‘We’ll buy you any book you want’ policy.

• 
We guarantee we’ll create the time, space and leadership (as well as the budget) to make sure you grow and develop.

• 
We want to set the pace, and don't cut corners when it comes to investing in tooling and technology that you need to be at the frontier of tech.

• 
We’re all about hiring clever people who are good humans too. It means Famly is full of top thinkers and generous teammates waiting to help you shine.

• 
We like to give a lot of ownership both in terms of responsibility and freedom to try new, challenging tasks.

• 
Top-notch work equipment (including noise cancelling headphones for those focus periods!).

• 
We believe collaboration happens best in person, so we have the default of four days a week in office - but with plenty of flexibility for when life happens outside the office too.

We're looking to fill the position as soon as possible, so get your application in today by sending us:

• 
Your CV

• 
Short and precise cover letter to tell us what you can bring to the role

• 
Portfolio (attached or linked) showcasing your work

Looking forward to hearing from you!

our product and our mission

our company and who we are

Join BEUMER Group and Shape the Future of Airport Security

Research area and project description:

The project involves fabrication of devices and their integration with the existing angle-resolved photoemission (ARPES) infrastructure at the ASTRID2 light source to discover quantum geometric effects and their link to new forms of transport phenomena.

• Isolation, twisting and stacking of monolayer metallic and semiconducting transition metal dichalcogenide, including materials that are sensitive to ambient conditions.

• Development of new techniques to isolate and integrate such air-sensitive materials with devices for photoemission experiments carried out in UHV conditions.

• Applying a state-of-the-art laser beamline integrated with the ASTRID2 synchrotron light source for femtosecond control of electronic structure of 2D materials.

jobs.description:
Applications are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Natural Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Physics and Astronomy programme. The position is available from February 2027 or later.

Research area and project description:

We are seeking a candidate for a fully funded 3-year PhD project at the Department of Physics and Astronomy, Aarhus University, in the new group of Asst. Prof. Christian Frydendahl, as part of a DFF Sapere Aude research grant.

Compact, integrable sources of circularly polarized light (CPL) are a key enabling technology for chip-scale quantum technologies, but electrically driven sources of pure CPL do not yet exist. Monolayer transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs) emit left- or right-handed CPL depending on which band structure valley, K or K', an electron-hole pair recombines in. Ordinarily, this occurs with an equal 50/50 split between the two valleys.

This project aims to build a new light-emitting diode geometry in which the Valley Hall effect, another intrinsic property of these materials, filters the valley index of the charge carriers during transport, enabling a purely electrically pumped source of CPL. Inducing valley polarization electrically rather than optically is one of the key open challenges in the emerging field of device-based valleytronics.

The project also includes a planned 6-month external research stay at the Singapore University of Technology and Design (SUTD), where you will develop and fabricate nanophotonic cavities for integration with the new diode design, enhancing its emission and CPL purity further via the Purcell effect.

Your general working tasks would be:

• van der Waals stacking of hBN-encapsulated TMDC monolayers

• Nanofabrication in the AU/SUTD cleanroom facilities (EBL, RIE, metal deposition)

• Opto-electronic characterization: probe station, polarization- and time-resolved spectroscopy at room- and cryogenic temperatures

• Publishing results and presenting at international conferences
